figurative_meaning_bn: আগে দুষ্কৃতি করত, এখন সাধু; দাগি অপরাধী
figurative_meaning_en: Someone who committed misdeeds in the past but is now pious; a habitual or marked offender
similar_in_english: Once a sinner, always a sinner
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে পুরানো পাপী, কিন্তু এখন সম্পূর্ণভাবে ধর্মপথে ফিরে এসেছে।
এই দাগি আসামীকে পুরানো পাপী বলে সবাই জানে।
example_sentences_in_english: He is an old sinner, but now he has completely turned to the path of righteousness.
Everyone knows this habitual offender as an old sinner.
note: The idiom often implies lingering suspicion despite apparent change, rooted in moral storytelling.
